quests.question: Despite three failed attempts, the climber was _____, returning to the mountain each spring until she finally reached the summit.
quests.explanation: Coming back year after year despite failure shows she refused to let go of her goal. Tenacious means holding firmly to a purpose and not giving up.

quests.question: The _____ owner paid for her employees' medical treatment and funded scholarships for their children.
quests.explanation: Paying for others' healthcare and education shows a kind wish to do good. Benevolent means well-meaning and generous toward others.

quests.question: Fame on social media is often _____: a video that goes viral is usually forgotten within a week.
quests.explanation: Being forgotten within a week shows how briefly it lasts. Ephemeral means lasting for a very short time.

quests.question: It was an _____ plan: three students with no funding proposed to turn an abandoned warehouse into a theatre.
quests.explanation: Having no money yet aiming so high shows a daring willingness to take risks. Audacious means bold and surprisingly ambitious.

quests.question: The manager asked for a _____ summary of the report, no more than three sentences.
quests.explanation: A three-sentence limit calls for short and to the point. Concise means expressing a lot in few words.

quests.question: The contract wording was _____: it could mean the fee was monthly or annual, and each side read it differently.
quests.explanation: Two sides reading it differently shows the text can mean more than one thing. Ambiguous means open to more than one interpretation.

quests.question: It was _____ of her to assume the landlord would return the deposit without any proof of the flat's condition.
quests.explanation: Expecting good treatment without taking precautions shows a lack of experience. Naive means too trusting and inexperienced.

quests.question: The reporter admitted she could not _____ the allegation, since none of her sources would go on record or show documents.
quests.explanation: Without testimony or documents she had no proof. To substantiate a claim is to support it with evidence.

quests.question: Planting trees along the riverbank will help _____ the damage from future floods.
quests.explanation: Trees soak up water and hold the soil, which makes flood damage less severe. To mitigate is to make something less harmful.

quests.question: The vote was _____: all twelve board members supported the proposal.
quests.explanation: All twelve in favour means complete agreement. Unanimous means agreed by everyone.

quests.question: She _____ deleted the entire folder while trying to rename a single file.
quests.explanation: She was only trying to rename a file, so the deletion was accidental. Inadvertently means without intending to.

quests.question: Taking painkillers on an empty stomach can _____ the problem rather than relieve it.
quests.explanation: 'Rather than relieve' tells us the effect is the opposite of helping. To exacerbate is to make a bad situation worse.

quests.question: 'Don't count on Marco when things get tough; he's a fair-weather friend.' What does this mean?
options: He is cheerful only in sunny weather
He is loyal only when things are going well
He is happy to help in any difficulty
He prefers outdoor activities with friends
quests.correctAnswer: He is loyal only when things are going well
quests.explanation: The warning about 'when things get tough' shows what the label means. A fair-weather friend disappears in difficult times.

quests.question: Our editor is so _____ that she once spent an hour arguing over whether a comma belonged before 'and'.
quests.explanation: Spending an hour on one comma shows excessive concern for tiny rules. Pedantic means overly fussy about minor details.

quests.question: Ana is naturally _____; she can't eat lunch alone and always ends up chatting at three different tables.
quests.explanation: Constantly seeking company shows how much she enjoys being around people. Gregarious means sociable and fond of company.

quests.question: Opening a small business there means dealing with endless _____: forms, stamps, and offices that send you to other offices.
quests.explanation: Forms and offices passing you along describe official red tape. Bureaucracy is a system with complicated rules and procedures.

quests.question: 'Absolutely not,' she said in an _____ tone that ended the discussion.
quests.explanation: A tone that closes the discussion is firm and forceful. Emphatic means expressed with strong force.

quests.question: Through every scandal, the fans remained _____ in their support, wearing the club's colours and filling the stadium.
quests.explanation: Staying loyal through scandal shows support that never weakened. Unwavering means steady and firm.

quests.question: Before sending any money, check that the charity is _____ by looking for its registration number.
quests.explanation: A registration number proves it is lawful and genuine. Legitimate means conforming to the law or rules.

quests.question: Rania told the team, 'I'm not saying the idea is bad; I'm saying it's early days.' What is she really implying?
options: It is too soon to judge, and the idea needs more work
She is sure the idea will succeed immediately
She wants the team to drop the idea at once
She believes the idea is perfect as it stands
quests.correctAnswer: It is too soon to judge, and the idea needs more work
quests.explanation: 'Early days' means not enough has happened yet to reach a verdict. She avoids rejecting the idea but signals it is unfinished.

quests.question: The difference in price was so _____ that it wasn't worth comparing shops.
quests.explanation: A difference not worth the effort of comparing is tiny. Negligible means so small it is hardly worth considering.

quests.question: The company offers an _____ to staff who cycle to work: a bonus of £10 for every week they do it.
quests.explanation: A reward for a behaviour encourages people to do it. An incentive is something that motivates action.

quests.question: Under the new law, banks must _____ all fees clearly, so that customers know exactly what they will pay.
quests.explanation: Making fees clear so customers can see them is the opposite of hiding them. To disclose is to reveal information.

quests.question: The mansion was _____: gold taps, a marble fountain, and a driveway lined with statues of the owner.
quests.explanation: Everything is designed to impress people with wealth. Ostentatious means showy in a way meant to attract attention.

quests.question: The watch's _____ mechanism contains over four hundred tiny parts that fit together like a puzzle.
quests.explanation: Hundreds of tiny interlocking parts describe a complicated, detailed design. Intricate means having many small, carefully arranged parts.

quests.question: When the investigation showed that he had followed every rule, Mr Okafor felt _____ after months of accusations.
quests.explanation: Being proved right after being blamed is the key idea. To feel vindicated is to feel cleared of blame.

quests.question: Her conclusions rest on _____ evidence: she recorded the behaviour of two hundred birds over three years.
quests.explanation: Systematic recording of observations is the basis of empirical work, unlike casual stories. Empirical means based on observation or experiment.

quests.question: It was a _____ thing to say; you don't ask a grieving widow how much the funeral cost.
quests.explanation: The remark ignored the widow's feelings. Tactless means lacking sensitivity in what you say.

quests.question: The journey was _____: eleven hours on a crowded bus, followed by a six-hour trek through mud.
quests.explanation: Long hours and mud suggest a hard, tiring effort. Arduous means involving great effort and endurance.

quests.question: She was _____ when the letter arrived confirming her place at medical school; she danced around the kitchen.
quests.explanation: Dancing around the kitchen shows overflowing joy. Elated means extremely happy and excited.
